description: Get one student's submission for an assignment with the Canvas rubric_assessment attached, keyed by criterion_id (rating_id, comments, points per criterion) — this does not carry the assessor's name or any grader identity. This is the same full submission object (score, grade, workflow_state, submitted_at) that get_submission returns, requested here with `include[]=rubric_assessment` instead of get_submission's default `submission_comments`; use get_submission when you also need comments or the submitted text/URL. Use submit_rubric_assessment to post a rubric assessment for a student rather than read one back.
name: get_rubric_assessment
title: Get Rubric Assessment
